description: Acetic acid water is a dilute aqueous acetic acid solution supplied as a laboratory diluent. It is used when a peptide reconstitutes poorly or gels in neutral water, a situation where a mildly acidic vehicle improves dissolution; it is also used as a solvent in analytical work. The concentration is documented per batch on the Certificate of Analysis because the catalogue does not fix a single strength for all applications.

faq.question: When should acetic acid water be used instead of sterile water?
faq.answer: It is used when a peptide dissolves poorly or gels in a neutral vehicle; a mildly acidic solution often improves dissolution. Confirm the choice against the solubility notes for your specific peptide.

faq.question: What concentration is the solution?
faq.answer: The catalogue does not fix a single strength: the concentration of each lot is stated on the batch Certificate of Analysis so that the exact value is traceable for your protocol.

faq.question: Is it safe to handle without special precautions?
faq.answer: Acetic acid solutions should be handled in a ventilated area with appropriate personal protective equipment and kept away from incompatible reagents; the pH is stated on the batch COA.

faq.question: What kit size is supplied?
faq.answer: Acetic acid water is supplied as 10 mL × 10 vials, with tiered wholesale discounts from 10% at 5+ kits to 30% at 50+ kits.

faq.question: Is this product for human or veterinary use?
faq.answer: No. All catalogue items are supplied strictly for laboratory research use only and are not for human or veterinary use, diagnosis, treatment or cosmetic application.
